summary: Iteration 24 — Automatic SellAuth product image sync end-to-end. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_image_sync_v24.py (12 cases, 12/12 pass) covering (a) sellauth._image_url helper ordering by pivot.order + empty/missing url paths, (b) POST /api/admin/sync/images auth gate: 401 unauth / 403 customer / 200 admin with `{ok:true, updated:int}` and idempotency (second run reports updated:0), (c) GET /api/products shows 17 SellAuth-linked products with https://api.sellauth.com/... image_url and BOTH Shundo products still on /images/snorlax.jpg + /images/gengar.jpg (unchanged), (d) POST /api/products with a sellauth_product_id and no image_url auto-fills the remote image and persists it via GET, (e) CRITICAL REGRESSION: PUT /api/products/{id} with `{badge: ...}` (image_url omitted) leaves the synced https:// image_url intact (verified by re-GET), (f) manual override via `image_url: '/images/x.jpg'` sets local file and a subsequent /api/admin/sync/images restores the remote URL (updated>=1), (g) changing sellauth_product_id refreshes image_url, price and sellauth_variant_id together, (h) GET /api/admin/sync/catalog dry-run returns 200 with creates/updates arrays (image_url is in syncable_fields per catalog_sync.py L8). Frontend Playwright at 1920x1080: storefront `/` (9 imgs, 0 broken) and `/products` (19 imgs, 0 broken — 17 remote sellauth.com + 2 Shundo local snorlax/gengar). Admin console login → Products tab: sync-images-btn present, click shows toast 'Images already current' (idempotent, screenshot captured). Edit first product: label reads exactly 'Image filename (optional)', input value is empty (no local override), product-image-preview.src = https://api.sellauth.com/storage/images/1127185.webp (SellAuth remote), Save without touching the field → API GET afterwards confirms image_url unchanged (regression fix works). Regression run: test_sellauth_launch_v6 + test_product_update_v4 = 29 passed, 6 skipped, 1 unrelated stale test failure (see below).

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: sellauth._image_url() sorts by (pivot.order,0) tuple with safe defaults — handles missing pivot/order and images=None cleanly. Unit-tested.

GOOD: sellauth_fields() only adds `image_url` to the update dict when SellAuth actually returned one, so a transient empty-images response from SellAuth cannot blank an existing image_url — the field is simply not touched. Combined with the frontend omitting image_url when blank+sellauth_id, this closes the regression window cleanly.
GOOD: sync_sellauth_images() only writes when image_url differs, so the idempotent second run genuinely reports updated:0 (verified live).
GOOD: POST /api/admin/sync/images is behind Depends(get_admin_user) — 401 for anonymous, 403 for customer verified.

GOOD: ProductEditor.jsx L102-109 payload build correctly omits image_url ONLY when image_file is blank AND a sellauth_product_id is present. If the id is cleared, image_url:'' IS sent to allow clearing. Nice branching.

GOOD: image_file init on L34-36 skips http:// URLs so a SellAuth-synced product opens with an empty filename field (not a garbled URL fragment), and localImage/remoteImage fallback on L134-138 shows the correct preview.
GOOD: Shundo pair (no sellauth_product_id) is left untouched by the sync loop — verified in production: /images/snorlax.jpg and /images/gengar.jpg both still render.
MINOR: server.py is now ~1900 lines. Extraction of the sync/image + catalog block into /app/backend/products_admin.py would help discoverability (carried from iter 23).

MINOR: The 'Refresh images' toast omits when the SellAuth API is unreachable — sync_sellauth_images() swallows per-product errors with logger.warning but returns the count of only-updated docs, so a partial failure looks like a success. Consider surfacing a `skipped: n` counter alongside `updated` in the response payload for observability. Not blocking.
